svg.text: Flame visuals on the 3-D map — jet · burning spots · burning man · scorch (CE-4635 / CE-4637)

Annotations in grey are not drawn by the app. Every flame, smoke and scorch below is drawn FROM THE SIMULATION'S STATE (design §6) — no per-frame state of its own: a replay, a pause and a second node draw the same.
A · a flamethrower's jet into a window — FlameJets.TryGet (U-1)
the jet: from mount jet.Mount's muzzle toward jet.AimPoint (its Target's position when it has one),
jet.RangeM long, widening to jet.HalfAngleRad, bright by jet.Intensity, flaring up from jet.BurstStartedAt;
lit while TryGet is true (≤ 0.25 s after the last fuel shot). v1 draws the full reach (the sim shortens it)
the room: a FireState spot on the building's
damage record — in the record's frame (U-2)
B · a burning truck — FireState on the vehicle, 3 spots (U-2)
each spot burning at now (IsBurning(now)): flames sized by Radius,
bright by Intensity, dying down over its last Seconds;
a small smoke each. Spots are in the TRUCK's frame — they move with it
⛔ replaces the one-flame-per-
wreck rule (EffectSystems.cs:422)
C · a napalm field — FireState on cell records (U-2) · scorch (U-4)
the big smoke: the strike's AreaEffectCloud — drawn today, unchanged (context)
burning cells: FireState spots on the ground cells' records (their frame);
where a cell's fire went out: its BurnedArea mark — a dark draped decal (U-4)
D · a burning man (U-3)
Effects.IsBurning(view, man, now)
(EffectState.BurningUntil), through
PersonLook: one body-sized spot
on him — it moves with him
E · scorched ground (U-4)
a BurnedArea item of GroundHeatMarks:
a dark decal draped on the ground,
Length × Width at its Heading — until
the record drops the mark
Scope: the five pictures only — the house, the truck's body, the treeline, the man's body and the strike's cloud are context (drawn today, unchanged).
